



```{r}
# ── Libraries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(tidyverse)
library(waffle)
library(showtext)
library(ggtext)

# ── Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read_csv("data/exhibitors_cphijp2026.csv")

# Deduplicate: one row per unique company × country × show_type
unique_exhibitors <- df %>%
  distinct(company_name, country, show_type)

# Count by show_type
show_counts <- unique_exhibitors %>%
  count(show_type, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# ── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
font_add_google("Alata", "title_font")
font_add_google("Noto Sans", "body_font")
showtext_auto()

# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cphi_colors <- c(
  "Ingredients" = "#E63946", # bold red
  "Outsourcing" = "#457B9D", # steel blue
  "Bio Pharma" = "#2A9D8F" # teal
)

# ── Labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
total <- sum(show_counts$n)

title_text <- "One Show, Three Worlds at CPHI Japan 2026"
subtitle_text <- glue::glue(
  "{total} unique exhibitor entries across <b style='color:#E63946'>Ingredients</b>, ",
  "<b style='color:#457B9D'>Outsourcing</b>, and <b style='color:#2A9D8F'>Bio Pharma</b>"
)
caption_text <- "Source: CPHI Japan 2026 Official Exhibitor List"

# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each square = 1 exhibitor entry (use values directly, or scale down if > 200)
# Here we scale: each square ≈ 2 exhibitors so the grid stays clean
waffle_data <- show_counts %>%
  mutate(n_scaled = round(n / 2)) |> # 1 square = ~2 exhibitors
mutate(show_type = factor(show_type, levels = c("Ingredients", "Outsourcing", "Bio Pharma")))  # ← add this


# Label vector
legend_labels <- show_counts %>%
  mutate(lbl = paste0(show_type, " (", n, ")")) %>%
  select(show_type, lbl) %>%
  deframe()   


```

# Viz
```{r}
p <- ggplot(waffle_data, aes(fill = show_type, values = n_scaled)) +
  geom_waffle(
    color = "white",
    size = 0.4,
    n_rows = 10,
    flip = FALSE, # ← change TRUE to FALSE
    make_proportional = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cphi_colors,
    labels = legend_labels   #

  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = title_text,
    subtitle = subtitle_text,
    caption = caption_text,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "body_font") +
  theme(
    # axes
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    # legend
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey20"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.4, "cm"),

    # title
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "title_font",
      face = "bold",
      size = 28,
      color = "grey10",
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_textbox_simple(
      family = "body_font",
      size = 14,
      color = "grey30",
      lineheight = 1.4,
      margin = margin(b = 16)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      family = "body_font",
      size = 10,
      color = "grey50",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 16)
    ),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#F8F9FA", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(24, 32, 16, 32)
  )

# ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
showtext_opts(dpi = 320)
ggsave("cphi_waffle.png", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 320)
showtext_auto(FALSE)
```



```{r}
library(magick)

# ── Save base plot first ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
showtext_opts(dpi = 320)
ggsave("cphi_waffle_nologo.png", p, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 108)  # 10 * 108 = 1080px
showtext_auto(FALSE)

# ── Canvas dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_width  <- 1080L
plot_height <- 1080L

# ── Read base plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_img <- image_read("cphi_waffle_nologo.png")
base_img <- image_resize(base_img, paste0(plot_width, "x", plot_height, "!"))  # force exact 1080x1080

# ── Read & resize logo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
logo_img <- image_read("logos/wide/satom-wide-color.png")
logo_target_width <- round(plot_width * 0.15)
logo_img <- image_scale(logo_img, as.character(logo_target_width))

logo_info   <- image_info(logo_img)
logo_width  <- logo_info$width
logo_height <- logo_info$height

# ── Position: bottom-right ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
margin_right  <- 30
margin_bottom <- 30

x_offset <- plot_width  - logo_width  - margin_right
y_offset <- plot_height - logo_height - margin_bottom

# ── Composite & save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
final_img <- image_composite(base_img, logo_img, offset = paste0("+", x_offset, "+", y_offset))

image_write(final_img, "cphi_waffle_1080x1080.png", format = "png")
```
